svg.title: Deposit and balance invoices
svg.desc: A chat that asks for part of the money upfront produces one draft with payment terms. Dueline splits the total in code: the deposit is the percentage rounded to the cent and the balance is the rest. The deposit invoice is created and sent now through PayPal. The balance invoice is saved as an unsent PayPal draft and appears in Ready to send on Home. When the freelancer clicks Send balance, the draft is re-dated to today, keeping its days to pay, and sent. The two amounts always add up to the job total.
svg.text: Two ordinary invoices instead of a partial payment.
Each is a complete invoice with its own SAC, purpose code and LUT line,
so the export register and GSTR-1 count each one once.

g.text: The chat asks for 50% now, so the form offers a deposit
Dueline splits the total in code. The balance is the rest
The deposit invoice is created and sent now
The balance is saved as a PayPal draft under its own request ID
The draft waits in Ready to send on Home
On delivery, Send balance re-dates the draft to today
PayPal sends it. Deposit plus balance equals the job total
